rationale.goal: Raise the needle RATE (needles per wall-clock hour) without raising the cost per line. dist_to_needles is dominated by |n_declared - n_true|: matched needles cost ~0.19 each on average while every count error costs UNMATCHED_PENALTY/max(n_disc,n_opt) ~= 0.35. Across the 5 showdown landscapes n_peaks is 28/78/8/83/18, and every existing config declares a near-constant count (dup1c ~14, dist1c ~30) regardless. The count model says the best constant count over these landscapes is ~78 (mean dist 4.84) versus ~30 (5.01) and ~14 (5.69) - the penalty for over-declaring saturates while the gain on peak-rich landscapes keeps paying, so the whole asymmetry favours MORE needles.
rationale.mechanism: Every needle in the 200-run showdown was declared by 'EI convergence' - the Jaccard force-declare never fired once. So a needle costs exactly one 5-line run of converged lines whose 5th line lands at zoom index >= min_zoom_for_needle (2). max_iterations < n_consecutive_converged (dup1c's structure) is what keeps an activation short: 2 lines per zoom, then advance. The number of chances to land that streak is the number of lines at zoom >= 2, which is (max_zooms - 2) * max_iterations.

per_hparam.max_iterations: 2 (dup1c). Below n_consecutive_converged=5 so each zoom advances after 2 lines instead of lingering; 2 is also the floor set by min_iters_per_zoom, under which no needle can ever be declared.
per_hparam.max_zooms: 4, NOT dup1c's 3. With max_zooms=3 only lines 5-6 sit at zoom>=2, so a needle needs lines 1-5 to converge in a row - dup1c converts only ~47% of activations and both worst_* configs (also max_zooms=3) declared ZERO needles. max_zooms=4 puts lines 5-8 at qualifying depth: four streak windows instead of two, for a 33% line cost. This corner (short activations WITH a reachable streak) is what MOBO never sampled - its trials sit at max_zooms=3 with short activations or max_zooms=9-10 with long ones.
per_hparam.nat_grad_max_steps: 10 (dist1c/dist2c) instead of dup1c's 400. The single biggest cost cut: dup1c pays 7.13 s/iter versus ~3.0 s/iter for the dist winners, which is why its short activations bought it no extra needles.
per_hparam.nat_grad_step: 0.1 (dist2c/dup1c). With only 10 mirror-ascent steps the step has to be large to move at all.
per_hparam.n_restarts / raw: 300/300 (dist1c). raw >= n_restarts avoids the GPSimplex resample-retry loop - worst_dist ran at raw=1 and declared no needles at all.
per_hparam.ucb_beta: 0.5. Interpolates between the dist winners' pure exploitation (0.001) and dup1c's max exploration (3.0). Exploitation is what makes a 5-line convergence streak complete inside a short activation; some beta is still needed to leave a basin once its needle ellipsoid is placed.
per_hparam.output_noise_threshold_mult: 2.0 (dup1c, top of range). The loosest EI convergence gate, so the 5-streak actually completes within an 8-line activation. Localisation loss is cheap: the matched-distance term is worth ~0.19 against ~0.35 per missed needle, and min_zoom_for_needle=2 still bounds how sloppy a declaration can be.
per_hparam.max_penalty_radius: 1.0 (dist1c). A cap on an ellipsoid semi-axis, not the ellipsoid itself - Hessian ellipsoids are usually far smaller, so it only binds on flat basins, where ~1.0 (about the simplex radius) stops one needle walling off the space.
per_hparam.top_m_points: 8 (3 of 4 good configs). The zoom box is the bounding box of the top-k unpenalised points; a larger k is a gentler zoom, which matters when each zoom level only sees 2 lines.
per_hparam.n_consecutive_converged: 5. Unanimous across all four good configs.
per_hparam.needle_shrink_factor / needle_stop_noise: 0.5 / 8.0 (dist2c, dup2c). Case-3 recovery resolves in a few retries and exits into the space-filling fallback instead of grinding through the 40-retry budget.
per_hparam.paring_spatial_halfnoise / paring_y_nois: 2.0 / 0.1 (dist1c). Aggressive spatial dedup keeps the GP small and fits fast; conservative Y merging keeps real peak values from being averaged away.
per_hparam.input_noise_threshold_mult: 6.0 (majority). Inert axis - DataHandler stores and serialises it but nothing in the optimiser reads it, which is why MOBO's trials drift to whichever bound they started near.

rationale.prediction: ~8 lines/activation at ~3 s/iter, so roughly 2x dist1c's needle rate: 50-70 needles per 0.5 h run against dist1c's ~30. If the count model holds this lands mean dist near 4.8-5.0 versus the current best 5.12. dup_fraction is expected to RISE, since it measures nearest-neighbour density over all measured points and this config measures more of them.
